def run(name,f,n):
    bestr=(1e9,None)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
    for trial in range(30):
        p0=rng.uniform(-2,2,size=n)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                res=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, max_nfev=1000)
            nm=np.mean(res.fun**2)/np.var(y)
            if np.isfinite(nm) and nm<bestr[0]: bestr=(nm,np.round(res.x,4))
        except Exception as e:
            pass
